notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Cards (8)': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer and The Phantom Menace; these count toward the 60.
The post is tagged Light, but the title ('Type 2 Dark Side Senators') and every card are Dark; side set to Dark.
The title and description call it a 'type 2' deck (Episode I-only environment). The Coruscant-set printings are used for Coruscant, Sense and Alter.
We Must Accelerate Our Plans is posted twice under Interrupts (x2 and, misspelled 'Wes Must Accelerate Our Plans', x 2), 4 total as published; the 'Interrupts (19)' header count includes both lines.

Posted 'Phanton Menace' dested The Phantom Menace; 'Yeb Yeb' dested Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'Orn Free Ta' dested Orn Free Taa; 'Podrace Collision' dested Podracer Collision; 'Motion is Supported' dested Motion Supported; 'Mauls Lightsaber' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'Drop' dested Drop!.
Allegations Of Corruption is the Coruscant Effect, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield (posted before Reflections III).
The section header lines ('Senators (11)', 'Non Senator Characters (12)' etc.) were removed.
